more_info.overview: Patent Blue V is used as a color in food. Its technological role is to add or restore food colour.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include dried fruit and vegetables, fruit and vegetables in vinegar oil or brine, canned or bottled fruit and vegetables, fruit and vegetable preparations excluding compote. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
Reported food-use estimates were below EFSA's limit.
Higher modelled exposure using maximum permitted levels could exceed the limit in children; it does not establish that those children experienced harm.
